name: Gillette Steel Center
old_description: Committed to providing excellent customer service, superior steel products, and timely delivery.
about:
Gillette Steel Center was founded in 1991 by Blaine and Susie Wilson in Gillette, Wyoming. The couple started the business to meet the need for a reliable steel supplier in the Powder River Basin area.

The company operates as a full-service steel distributor with value-added processing. Its 30,000-square-foot warehouse and 6,000-square-foot office house over 3,500 tons of inventory, including structural steel (A36, A572-50, A633, T-1, Hardox), stainless steel, aluminum, and bar grating. Processing capabilities include CNC cutting, plate forming, shearing, sawing, fabrication, cut-to-length, burning, and 700-ton press work. Monthly shipments exceed 1,500 tons.

Gillette Steel serves customers across Northeast Wyoming and the broader Rocky Mountain region, with a 350-mile delivery radius reaching neighboring states. Its client base includes industrial and construction projects in the Powder River Basin, though specific industry sectors are not detailed publicly.

The company emphasizes same-day delivery for in-stock items and prompt scheduled deliveries, backed by a fleet of commercial trucks. It cites its legacy of quality, competitive pricing, and state-of-the-art equipment as key differentiators.
